content.statute: MSMED Act 2006; Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises Order, 2012 (S.O. 581(E), effective 1 April 2012; minimum procurement percentage raised from 20% to 25% by order dated 9 November 2018)
content.summary: Every Central Ministry, Department and Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSU) must procure a minimum of 25% of its total annual goods/services value from Micro and Small Enterprises. Within that 25%, at least 4% must be sourced from MSEs owned by SC/ST entrepreneurs and at least 3% from MSEs owned by women entrepreneurs.

compliance.text: Compliance is monitored by the Ministry of MSME via the MSME Sambandh portal, where CPSUs publish monthly and annual procurement factsheets.

tenderBenefits.text: 25% minimum annual procurement from MSEs by every Central Ministry/Department/CPSU, with a 4% sub-target for SC/ST-owned MSEs and a 3% sub-target for women-owned MSEs.
